The Chinese characters for Robert

As a transliteration, Robert is usually written 罗伯特 (Luó bó tè). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

罗
Luó
net, collect
伯
bó
uncle, earl
特
tè
special

Origin and meaning

From Germanic, Robert carries the meaning “bright fame”.

About the name Robert

Robert the Bruce led Scotland to independence from England.

As a gift or a tattoo

People often order Robert as a framed gift or as a tattoo — the meaning, “bright fame”, is part of the appeal.
